record.one_liner: Open-source command-line tool (mmdc) that renders Mermaid diagram definitions into SVG, PNG, or PDF, including from Markdown files.
record.auth_notes: Local tool with no hosted service and no authentication.
record.access_notes: Free MIT-licensed npm package (@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli), also available as Docker/Podman images. No credentials needed. It runs locally, so an agent toolkit would need a runtime (Node plus a headless browser) rather than calling a remote API. I did not verify the browser dependency on the fetched page.
record.blocker: No hosted REST API. It is a local CLI and Node library, and the Node API is not covered by semver. An agent toolkit has to run it in a sandbox or container. No official MCP server was found; community servers exist.

evidence.auth: https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli (README: no authentication described; local CLI)
evidence.api: https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli (CLI mmdc and Node.js run() API, which is not covered by semver)
evidence.mcp: https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli (no MCP mention); the web search showed only community MCP servers (hustcc/mcp-mermaid, peng-shawn/mermaid-mcp-server). I did not fetch those pages.
